purpose: Map every SGFX-relevant CTitleStateMenu / CTitleStateWorldMap / CHudPause / CHudSonicStage state-machine PPC function to its on-disk auto-translated PPC C++ body. The recompiled UnleashedRecomp.exe doesn't expose the sub_XXXX PPC symbols Ghidra needs (XenonRecomp translates them into x64 functions with new addresses), so the auto-translated source files in local_build_env/ur103clean/UnleashedRecompLib/ppc/ppc_recomp.*.cpp are the static-decompile oracle. This map lets future retroactive ports target the right body directly.
ghidra_status: Ghidra analyzeHeadless on the existing project (sward_unleashed_recomp_context, programs phase222_smoke.exe / phase254_owner_layout_noanalysis.exe) returns UNRESOLVED for every PPC sub_ symbol because the analyzed program is the recompiled x64 binary, not the original Xbox 360 default.xex. To get Ghidra-side PPC decompiles a future phase would import the original .xex file from extracted_assets.
